CLARVIS

Every animation of the clarvis mod, drawn by the mod's own code into truecolor cells and painted as Ghostty paints them: quadrant blocks (2 × 2 subpixels a cell) in a 10 × 24 px cell on #1B1B29. Below the band views: the AVENGERS THEATER (the engine's own frames) and the STARK ARCADE game. Add ?w=160 for a wider band, ?sheet=hulk&n=10 for a contact sheet, ?theater=8&n=6 for a movie's contact sheet.

STARK ARCADE · /clarvis play

Screens from the game pane, rendered by the game's own engine. The title offers five games, each in its own colour: 1 ULTRON SIEGE (repulsor SPACE; 1 Cap's shield, 2 Mjölnir, 3 Hulk SMASH; Ultron Prime every 4th wave) · 2 CIVIL WAR (pick a side, draft 3 of 6, tag with Z) · 3 and 4 ARENA (any of 16 fighters vs any, four AI tiers) · 5 ENDGAME vs THANOS (break or parry the snap). Every fight: select → HOW TO PLAY → VS → fight → ranked results. Sprites scale with the pane, down to an 11-row inline pane.
